materials.text:

materials.text:

C正确：小却有意义的看法课；D装饰、B无关反向，A自动不表影响。

units.title: 高级完形：旧水壶修好后的声音

materials.title: Kettle Familiar Sound
materials.text:
When an old electric kettle stopped working, its owner brought it to a repair event with an unusual request. She wanted it to sound exactly as it had before. The volunteer could examine the fault, but he could not ____1____ that a successful repair would restore every familiar detail.

They discussed what mattered to her. The kettle had belonged to her father, and its ordinary noise had become linked with mornings in his kitchen. She was asking about memory as well as ____2____. The two concerns deserved attention, but they were not the same technical task.

The volunteer explained what work could be checked and what remained uncertain. He did not dismiss the emotional reason for the request. He also avoided making a ____3____ that the equipment and his experience could not support.

After the repair, the kettle worked but sounded slightly different to its owner. She was disappointed at first. Then she realised that the difference did not ____4____ the years for which the earlier sound had mattered. A repaired object could continue a history without repeating it perfectly.

The event's record described the completed work in practical terms. It did not claim that a memory had been restored. This ____5____ protected the meaning of the repair from being stretched into something else.

The owner kept the kettle and wrote down the story of why she had brought it. The account gave the emotional importance a place of its own. A useful service could ____6____ a personal attachment without pretending to reproduce the past. The volunteer's honesty had made room for a more ____7____ understanding of the result, even when the outcome could not ____8____ the original hope.

questions.explanation: D正确：无法保证所有熟悉细节恢复；C记、A找、B买非对未来维修效果承诺。
C正确：既记忆又器物运作function；A装饰、D翻译、B出席不表停机需修的另一任务。
A正确：不许能力不支持的承诺promise；B比、C限、D记不表夸未来结果。
D正确：新声差异不抹去旧日意义；B证实、C借、A宣不表达保存历史。
D正确：实修与恢复记忆之区别限制概念扩张；C发明、A距离、B付费非文段分类。
C正确：服务承认个人依恋但不装复原过去；A忽略反向，D替代、B量化非情感尊重。
D正确：诚实促现实理解维修结果；C壮观、A强制、B统一非承认能力限度。
C正确：不能实现最初希望fulfil；D延期、B掩、A模仿非希望达成的标准动词。

units.title: 高级完形：礼堂温度计测不到的感受

materials.title: Hall Temperature Reading
materials.text:
The manager of a community hall received conflicting comments about its temperature. Some guests felt cold, while others found the same event uncomfortable in the opposite way. A single reading on the wall did not seem to ____1____ everyone's experience.

Before changing the settings, the manager asked where people had been sitting and what activities had taken place. A guest near an open doorway had experienced a different situation from someone in the centre of a crowded room. The disagreement was not necessarily evidence that anyone had been ____2____.

The hall began recording the conditions beside each complaint. This did not turn personal comfort into a precise number. It helped the manager identify a ____3____ that a bare total of positive and negative comments would have hidden.

One volunteer suggested asking only whether people were satisfied. The manager wanted more specific accounts. A useful comment would ____4____ a feature that could be checked, such as a draught near a door, instead of requiring staff to guess what “too cold” referred to.

Several changes followed, including how the room was arranged before different events. None could guarantee identical comfort for every guest. The aim was a more ____5____ response to the circumstances, not a claim that the thermometer should replace human reports.

The reading remained useful. Its role was ____6____ rather than absolute: it belonged beside descriptions, not above them. The hall had learned to ____7____ a measurement with experience without forcing either to settle every question. Listening to a disagreement could produce a better ____8____ of the room than simply choosing which voice to believe.

questions.explanation: B正确：单读数难代表人人体验；A修、D禁、C资助非温度值描述作用。
B正确：不同感受不证有人不诚实；A在场、D受邀、C舒适不是相反报道真实性问题。
A正确：附位置活动看出规律pattern；D价格、B截止、C收据不是情境对应。
D正确：意见指出可核特征identify；A藏、B延、C仿不表具体化检查对象。
C正确：依情境更恰当appropriate反应；B自动不合听人，D远、A相同与不同需求反向。
D正确：测量辅助而非绝对，supporting；B装饰无用、A独占反向，C永久不表证据角色。
C正确：结合读数与体验不强任何一个全解释；B混淆、A替代、D惩罚不合。
C正确：听差异形成更好理解房间；B限、A译、D许可非认识成果。

units.title: 高级完形：旧市场价格表的比较

materials.title: Old Market Price
materials.text:
A class studying an old market notice was fascinated by the small prices printed beside everyday goods. One pupil said that life must have been cheap. The teacher asked what would be needed before that ____1____ could be justified.

A price expressed in an old currency could not simply be read as though its number had the same meaning today. Nor would converting the currency settle everything. What mattered also included wages, quantities and the ____2____ of what was being sold.

The class chose one product and looked for more information about its unit of sale. A basket in the notice did not necessarily match the basket a modern shopper imagined. The word named a container while leaving its capacity ____3____.

They also found a wage record, but it concerned one occupation rather than every resident. The teacher encouraged them to use it with that ____4____ in mind. A concrete figure could be informative without standing for a whole town.

Their final display kept the attractive old notice and added questions beside it. The class did not ____5____ comparison; it made the basis of comparison more visible. Visitors could see why a small number alone was not proof of an easy life.

One pupil wanted a single modern equivalent for every price. The group explained why that would suggest more ____6____ than the evidence allowed. A careful account might remain incomplete while being more useful than a ____7____ answer. The exercise taught them to ask what two numbers had to share before treating them as genuinely ____8____.

questions.explanation: B正确：便宜生活是待证结论conclusion；C测量、D许可、A翻译非推断。
A正确：比较商品还需品质，配工资数量；D装饰、C出席、B距离不表同商品价的关键属性。
B正确：篮词未定容量故uncertain；C自动、D同一、A强制不合未知。
C正确：单职业工资不能代全镇是限制；B收据、A庆、D所有非推论边界。
C正确：不弃比较而显依据；B保证、A借、D藏非保留活动并审慎方法的对比。
A正确：单一现代等价易装过度精确；C名气、D色、B大方非证据数值准确。
D正确：审慎不全胜误导答案；C有限定、A暂定、B有记录可能正是审慎优点，非被对照的错误。
D正确：两数字需共同条件才可比较；C可搬、B历史、A私人不是比较有效性。

units.title: 高级完形：为电影写下可见的动作

materials.title: Film Action Description
materials.text:
In a film workshop, participants were asked to describe a silent scene without explaining the characters' motives. The task sounded easy until several realised how quickly description became ____1____. “She leaves the room” had turned into “She escapes because she is ashamed.”

The tutor asked what the image actually showed. A quick departure could be seen; shame was an inference. It might be a reasonable one, but it needed to remain ____2____ from the action that prompted it. Another viewer might explain the same movement differently.

The group compared their sentences. Some had overlooked a pause before the door opened. Others had treated a glance as proof of hostility. Discussing these details made the scene feel more complex, not less ____3____. There was still a story to follow, but more than one route through its meaning.

For the second attempt, participants wrote two lines: one describing an action and another suggesting a possible interpretation. This arrangement ____4____ the movement from observation to explanation. It did not require them to avoid judgement forever; it asked them to notice when they were making one.

When sound was restored, a short remark changed several impressions. The earlier descriptions were not all worthless, but some explanations now needed ____5____. The tutor encouraged participants to preserve both drafts so they could see how an added detail had altered the account.

The exercise offered a lesson in ____6____ attention. A confident account could hide the choices that had produced it. By making those choices ____7____, the group gained more freedom to discuss them. Description had become a method of opening a question rather than ____8____ closing it.

questions.explanation: C正确：动作描述加羞耻动机已成解释；A装饰、D许可、B出席非推断转换。
A正确：动机推断须与动作分开distinct；B同一反向；D可搬、C强制非证据区分。
C正确：复杂不减吸引力engaging，后仍可跟故事；D熟悉程度未谈，B成本、A空不合复杂而仍有意思。
C正确：双行显出观察到解释的过渡；B藏、D禁、A买不表可见。
D正确：恢复声音带新信息需修订解释；B庆、A付款、C模仿不合纠正认知。
D正确：区分两层需有纪律关注disciplined；B自动相反，A私密、C远非方法专注。
C正确：选择明确说出便可讨论；D永久、B沉默反向、A敌意不合。
B正确：打开问题不应过早闭合prematurely；A耐心、D偶然、C渐进不是未经证据就定论的要害。

units.title: 高级完形：词典释义之后的例句

materials.title: Dictionary Example Setting
materials.text:
A learner checking a familiar word in a dictionary may stop at the first definition. The meaning looks recognisable, so further reading seems unnecessary. Yet an example can carry information about a word's use that the definition alone cannot ____1____.

A teacher demonstrated this with a polite request from a short dialogue. The individual words were simple, but replacing one with a near synonym made the sentence sound unusually ____2____. The learner had preserved a broad meaning while changing the relationship between speakers.

Rather than announcing that the new word was wrong in every situation, the teacher asked where it might sound natural. The class suggested a formal letter and compared that setting with the conversation. This made the problem one of ____3____, not merely a contest between a correct word and an incorrect one.

The dictionary examples offered further clues. Some showed a common grammatical pattern; others suggested a typical audience or tone. The teacher reminded learners that an example was not a complete ____4____ of every possible use. It was a place to begin noticing patterns.

For homework, students collected another sentence and explained the situation in which they had found it. Copying without context would have reduced the task to a ____5____ of words. The explanation required them to think about who was speaking and why.

The lesson did not make definitions obsolete. It put them beside other kinds of information. A useful reference could ____6____ understanding without replacing attention to a particular exchange. Knowing a word included recognising both its possible meanings and the ____7____ that made one use appropriate. An ordinary example could therefore reward a second ____8____.

questions.explanation: A正确：例句传达用法信息，convey；C买、D禁、B修非参考资料作用。
A正确：近义替换使过正式，下文formal letter适用；C随便反向，B静、D饿不描述语体。
C正确：情境合适度非绝对对错；D所有、B测量、A出席不表语体匹配。
B正确：单例非所有用法完整清单inventory；C邀请、A翻译、D限制不表穷尽范围。
B正确：无语境抄只成词语集合；A许可、C预测、D修非堆词结果。
D正确：资料支持理解不代具体交流关注；B抹、C保证超能力、A替代违without replacing。
C正确：周围情境使某用法适合；A价、D色、B签名非交流条件。
B正确：普通例句值得再读reading；C买、D假、A截止不合词典学习。

units.title: 高级完形：旅行日记中被删掉的一次迟疑

materials.title: Travel Journal Edits
materials.text:
Preparing a travel journal for friends, I removed several passages in which I had been uncertain about what to do. The edited version moved smoothly from one place to another. It was easier to read, but it gave a ____1____ account of how the journey had felt.

A friend who had travelled with me noticed the missing hesitation at a station. In the journal, I had simply chosen the right platform. In reality, we had compared two signs, asked a member of staff and changed our first decision. Those actions had been ____2____ into a result.

I had not intended to make myself look unusually competent. I had cut the episode because I thought uncertainty would interrupt the story. Yet the uncertainty explained why the later choice mattered. Removing it had ____3____ the reader of a reason to understand our relief.

I restored a shorter version of the scene. It did not need every wrong turn, but it needed enough to show how the decision had been made. The revision made the journal more ____4____ without turning it into a minute-by-minute report.

Editing still required selection. No account could contain everything, and a diary intended for friends was not a complete ____5____ of a journey. The question was whether an omission changed the meaning of what remained.

I now read my drafts with that question in mind. A polished sequence can ____6____ the work of finding a way through an unfamiliar place. Keeping a moment of hesitation may make the narrative less ____7____ while making the experience more recognisable. The story can move forward without pretending that the traveller had known the answer from the ____8____.

questions.explanation: B正确：去迟疑使体验被扭曲distorted；A强制、C便携、D慷慨不表记述失真。
B正确：核标问人改决定多动作被压缩成结果；C扩反向；A修、D借不表删减过程。
C正确：deprived reader of reason表示剥去理解欣慰的理由；B relieved of表示解除负担，理由不是需解除负担；D informed与A reminded虽常接of但表示给信息/提醒，与删除导致缺失相反。
D正确：留真实决策使记述更诚实；B秘密、C贵、A确定反不留迟疑。
C正确：游记不是穷尽全程的清单inventory；B许可、D预测、A邀请不表完整列举。
D正确：顺滑叙事可能遮找路工作；C庆、A测、B要求非编辑省略所隐过程。
B正确：留迟疑少无缝但体验可辨；C戏剧性常可能增加，D熟悉并非顺序连贯，A资讯量常增加非所减。
B正确：from outset从一开始，非D天花、C收据、A照片。
